DOMAIN: THE TOPIC AREA OF A COMPLETE EMAIL
A domain is the broad business, service, societal, or personal topic area addressed by the main content of an email: what area of life or service is the message about?
Domain does not mean an Internet domain name. It describes the underlying topic area, rather than the message's immediate action, format, event, urgency, or persuasive technique.
Judge the domain from the email's central subject, or from a substantial separate context supported by the whole message. A requested action such as clicking a link, confirming details, making a payment, or recovering an account is not a domain by itself.

Evaluate each named domain below against the complete email. Do not invent narrower versions of these domains. A domain with insufficient evidence is a non-match; if none match, the email can be labelled Undetermined.

Include employee scheduling, internal policies, staff records, and internal payroll matters. Exclude external job vacancies, applications, interviews, and career opportunities unless an independent internal workplace context is also substantial.

Valued Customer, Please note that starting from March 22, 2016, we will be introducing new online banking authentication procedures in order to protect the private information of all online banking users. You are required to confirm your online banking details with us as you will not be able to have access to your accounts until this has been done. As you're already registered for online banking all you need to do is to confirm your online banking details. Confirm your details Once you've completed this you'll be able to manage your money whenever you want, giving you more control of your finances. Regards Customer Service Santander Bank
